title: Meeting room booking and cancellation
text: Members reserve meeting rooms in the portal. Cancel at least 4 hours before the start to restore the booking credit. If nobody checks in within 15 minutes after the start, the system releases the room and the booking credit is used.

title: Meeting room capacity and equipment
text: Lock Room seats 4 and has a whiteboard and USB-C display. Basin Room seats 8 and has a video conferencing camera and HDMI display. Each room can be booked in 30-minute increments. Catering is allowed in Basin Room only.

title: Quiet floor and phone booths
text: The second floor is designated for quiet work. Calls must be taken in a phone booth or meeting room. Phone booths are first come, first served and have a 30-minute limit when others are waiting. Leave booths empty between calls.

title: Podcast studio and orientation
text: Studio members may reserve the podcast studio after completing the 20-minute equipment orientation. Book through the portal at least 24 hours ahead. The studio rotates four microphone kits; guests may use the studio only when accompanied by the booking member.

title: After-hours meeting room access
text: A booking does not extend building access beyond 10:00 p.m. Guests may use a booked room only while their host is present and subject to the applicable guest policy. Weekend guest registration is governed by ACCESS-02.
